remarks: This charming, renovated four-bedroom, two full bath home is nestled in the heart of Norwalk, offering both comfort and convenience. Ideally situated, this home provides easy access to schools, shops, restaurants, and all other amenities found within the metropolitan city. Residents will enjoy the proximity to everyday necessities. Step inside to a bright and cozy living space adorned with luxury vinyl flooring and recessed lighting throughout. The spacious kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and an abundance of cabinetry, perfect for culinary enthusiasts and families alike. Main floor laundry adds to the convenience, streamlining household chores without sacrificing style or function. Designed for modern living, the home boasts an open-floor plan, creating an inviting atmosphere for gatherings or relaxation. If you are searching for a home that blends contemporary design with an ideal location, this home is truly the perfect choice.
